item.title: Slang Term 'Choppelganger,' Combining 'Doppelganger' And 'Chopped,' Growing On Social Media
item.description: Choppelganger is a slang term describing someone who looks like a chopped version of you, meaning they look less attractive. The term began spreading online as early as May 2025 on X / Twitter, becoming increasingly popular over the following months on sites including TikTok and X. The term is a portmanteau of the words "chopped" and "doppelganger."

item.title: Trump Pulls Off A Flawless 'Ahegao' Face While Doing A Tasteless Impression, Inspiring Memes
item.description: Trump Trans Weightlifter Impression or Trump Ahegao Face is a series of memes, including image macros and photoshops, based on a video of U.S. President Donald Trump doing an impression of a transgender weightlifter during a January 2026 speech at the Trump-Kennedy Center as part of a House GOP member retreat. A clip of the impression went viral on social media on January 6th, 2026 and inspired memes that day, some of which compare Trump's face while doing the impression to an ahegao face.

item.title: Song Mourning A Grandmother's Death By Bazooka Goes Viral, Inspiring Dancing, Reactions
item.description: Kaboom Kablow, also known as Rest In Peace My Granny, She Got Hit By A Bazooka, refers to the song "Bazooka" by rapper Miami XO. The song, which features lyrics where the rapper mourns the death of his grandmother by bazooka, was released on December 29th, 2025 across streaming platforms. It went viral over the following days on sites including TikTok and X / Twitter for its absurd lyrics, inspiring memes and reactions.
